name: zeroclaw
description_en: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀
readme_excerpt: 🦀 ZeroClaw — Personal AI Assistant You own the agent. You own the data. You own the machine it runs on. Docs · Philosophy · Quick start · Architecture · Discord ZeroClaw is an agent runtime — a single Rust binary you configure and run. It talks to LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and ~20 others), reaches the world through 30+ channels (Discord, Telegram, Matrix, email, voice, webhooks, your own CLI), and acts through tools (shell, browser, HTTP, hardware, custom MCP servers).
